questions.q:
The critical micelle concentration CMC of a cationic colloidal electrolyte is 10-3 M . If 1 mm3 contains 1013 micelles, the number of cations making one micelle is 
(Given, NA=6.0×1023 mol-1 )
questions.solution:
At CMC, the number of cationic colloidal particles =10-3×6.0×1023= 6.0×1020 per L

Therefore, number of particles per mm3
= 6.0×1020106∵1L=106mm3
= 6.0×1014 particles/ mm3

Number of micelles in 1 mm3= 1013 (given)
Number of cations forming one micelle
=6.0×10141013
=60 cations

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following is less than zero during adsorption?

Adsorption is process where randomness decreases and energy is released. Hence, ΔS will be negative (as randomness is decreasing) and ΔH will also be negative ( ΔH is negative for exothermic processes).
Depending on the values of Entropy and enthalpy, the Gibbs energy can either be negative or positive.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Adsorption of gases on solid surface is generally exothermic because
questions.solution:
Thermodynamics of adsorption:

i. ΔS<0 because gaseous phase decrease
ii. ΔG<0 because process is spontaneous
so ΔG=ΔH-TΔS
-ve=ΔH-+ve-ve
ΔH=-ve
iii. ΔH<0 so adsorption is an exothermic process.

Water has large surface tension due to very strong interaction. Generally adding organic derivatives to water decreases its surface tension due to hydrophobic interaction.

In case III, hydrophobic interaction is stronger than case II causing surface tension to decrease more rapidly.

Due to K+ Cl– (inorganic electrolyte) intermolecular forces increases, surface tension increases.

questions.q:
Which of the following set is having correct statements for enzyme catalysis?
1. Each enzyme is specific for a given reaction
2. The enzyme activity is maximum at optimum pH
3. The enzymatic activity is increased in presence of certain substances called  co-enzymes
4. The favourable temperature range of enzyme activity is between 50-60 °C
questions.solution: Here statement 1, 2 and 3 are correct and 4 one is incorrect as the favourable temperature range for enzymatic activity is <math><mn>25</mn><mo>-</mo><mn>37</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> . enzymatic activity is destroyed at about <math><mn>70</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> .

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which statement is correct about chemisorptions?
options: It involves formation multi layer of adsorbent on adsorbate
It involves the weak attractive forces between adsorbent and adsorbate
questions.solution: Chemical adsorption is irreversible due to formation of new strong chemical bonds. It is unilayer due formation of new chemical bonds. It first increases with increase in temperature due to supply of energy of activation then decreases due to breaking of covalent bond.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Which of the following statements are correct about zeolite?
1. Zeolites are aluminosilicates having three dimensional network
2. Shape selectivity of zeolites depends upon porous structures of the catalyst
3. Zeolites are synthetic microporous aluminosilicates which do not exist naturally
4. Zeolites are open structures of silica in which trivalent aluminium substitute by a fraction of silicon atoms
questions.solution: Zeolites are naturally occurring or synthetic microporous aluminosilicates which are used to remove permanent hardness from hard water. Shape selectivity of zeolites depends upon porous structures of the catalyst.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The flocculating power of the given ions for the specified colloidal sols will be such that
options:
Arsenic sulphoid sol Ferric hydroxide sol
FeCN64->PO43->SO42->Cl- Al3+>Ba2+>Na+

Arsenic sulphoid sol Ferric hydroxide sol
Al3+>Ba2+>Na+ FeCN64->PO43->SO42->Cl-

Arsenic sulphoid sol Ferric hydroxide sol
Na+>Ba2+>Al3+ Cl->SO42->PO43->FeCN64-

Arsenic sulphoid sol Ferric hydroxide sol
Cl->SO42->PO43->FeCN64- Na+>Ba2+>Al3+
questions.solution:
Coagulation power depends on nature of charge and amount of charge
Coagulation power ∝ charge on ion of electrolyte
As Arsenic sulphoid sol is negatively charged so for it cations will cause precipitation of ions and the order is Al3+>Ba2+>Na+
As Ferric hydroxide sol is positively charged so for it anions will cause precipitation of ions and the order is FeCN64->PO43->SO42->Cl-
